steps.npc: Hello there, human. Welcome to my humble little inn. Perfect place to have a nice relax after a hard day in the mines. Can I get you anything?

options.text: Do you get many customers here?

steps.player: Do you get many customers here?

steps.npc: Oh yes, very much so. We're one of the only stop-offs on long journeys from east to west. Plenty of sailors like to have a little break here.
Then of course you have the workers here. It often feels like they yearn for the mines, but I've thankfully just about managed to teach them to take care of themselves from time to time as well.

steps.player: Sounds like they're lucky to have you.

steps.npc: Oh they very much are! Korgan may be the one paying them and keeping them well equipped, but make no mistake, it's me and my stews that are keeping them alive!
Speaking of which, I can sort you out with a stew yourself if you want? Or maybe you'd prefer a drink?
